fusions.name: Sawtooth Chop
fusions.desc: A serrated chop that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thresher's Stroke
fusions.desc: Whips a bladed tail through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Whetted Edge
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 35% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hewn Open
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
